description: Implement media catalog module (Task 17.1): REST endpoints for library tracks (cursor-based pagination), playlists (CRUD), and likes (add/remove/list). All JWT-protected.
steps: Create apps/api/src/library/library.service.ts with methods: listTracks(userId, cursor?, limit?), getTrack(userId, trackId), listPlaylists(userId), getPlaylist(userId, playlistId), createPlaylist(userId, title, description?), updatePlaylist(userId, playlistId, data), addTrackToPlaylist(userId, playlistId, trackId), removeTrackFromPlaylist(userId, playlistId, trackId), listLikes(userId, cursor?, limit?), addLike(userId, trackId), removeLike(userId, trackId)
Implement cursor-based pagination for listTracks and listLikes: use createdAt/id as cursor, return { items, cursor, hasMore }

Create apps/api/src/library/library.controller.ts with JWT-protected routes: GET /library/tracks, GET /library/tracks/:id, GET /library/playlists, GET /library/playlists/:id, POST /library/playlists, PATCH /library/playlists/:id, POST /library/playlists/:id/tracks (body: {trackId}), DELETE /library/playlists/:playlistId/tracks/:trackId, GET /library/likes, POST /library/likes/:trackId, DELETE /library/likes/:trackId

Create apps/api/src/library/__tests__/library.service.spec.ts testing: listTracks returns paginated results, createPlaylist creates record, addLike creates record, removeLike deletes record, addTrackToPlaylist increments trackCount
Run pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run lint, pnpm run build, pnpm run test
acceptance_criteria: Track can be added/removed from playlist
findings: All verification steps pass: tests (126 passed), typecheck, lint, and build all succeed. Pre-commit hooks (eslint + prettier) ran successfully.
